name: Two of Wands
keywords: what you have and what you want

facts.rooftop: He stands on a stone parapet atop a castle wall, looking down at the waterside and the land.
facts.globe: In one hand he holds a small globe and looks into it.
facts.wand-held: In the other hand he grips one wand, and another wand on the right is fixed to a ring in the wall.
facts.rose-lily: On a stone slab at the lower left is a design of a red rose and a white lily crossed.
facts.cap-cloak: A man in a red cap and a purple cloak stands in profile.
facts.landscape: Below spread the waterside, green land, distant mountains and a single house with a red roof.

glosses.globe: Holding the world in his hand and gauging the next destination.
glosses.wand-held: One held and one left standing: a fork between leaving and staying.

reversedGloss.blocked: Ready to leave, but familiarity holds back the feet.
reversedGloss.internalized: Unchanged on the outside, but drawing the next direction inside.

misdescriptions.wrong: Two people are standing on the castle.
He is holding a crystal ball.
He holds a wand in each hand.
